main_text.p: נָעַשׁ Concuti, Commoveri. Pihel נִעַשׁ & Hithpahel הִתְנַעֵשׁ Idem.
נֶפֶן גְּפָנִים f. Vitis: plur. נְפָנִים.
גֶּפֶּא גָּפָה Corpus: item Ala, Pinna: plurale, Chald. גְּפָּא Ala.
גָּרָה Pihel, Miscere, Suscitare lites. Hithpahel הִתְגָּרָה Idem.
תִּגְרָה f. Conflictus. גָּרוֹן, גָּרָה Vide גּוּר.
גָּרַז Niphal נִגְרַז Excindi, גָּרוֹן m. Securis.
גּוֹרָל גּוֹרָל m. Sors: plur. גּוֹרָלוֹת.
גַּרְמִים גְּרָם m. Os ossis: Fastigium: plur. גַּרְמַיִם Chald. גַּרְמֵיהוֹן Ossa eorum, Dan. 6. 23.
גָּרָן f. Area, Horreum: plur. גְּרָנוֹת.
גָּרַע & Pihel גֵּרַע Minuit, Detraxit, Subtraxit. Niphal נִגְרַע Diminui, Detrahi, Subtrahi.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are approximate; the scan is small and the pointing is hard to read, so forms with doubtful vowels or letters should be checked against the original. The reading of the last entry's Latin word ("Conuerrit") and of the Hebrew in the entry "Vide" line is uncertain. The Hebrew running head and catchword are copied as seen.
